chapters.label: Live: the 2012 final
chapters.text: The 2012 UEFA Futsal Cup final, in Lleida. In the second minute, Wilde, from Brazil, shoots Barcelona ahead against Dinamo Moscow! Barça win three one, and Wilde is man of the match.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Wilde played pivot, up front. This is his power turn: back to goal, he takes the ball. He sinks low and leans into the defender. He feels where the defender is, then turns and shoots!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Low, strong, turn!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: back to goal, stay strong, don’t get pushed off, then turn!
